limitations: Engine frame percentiles saturate at 2000 ms and frame durations >=10000 ms are omitted entirely.
Whole-frame timings include the rest of the active game. Lua stopwatch resolution is one millisecond.
The original coverage guard mislabeled missing frames as focus loss. Preserve batch errors for audit, but do not use that wording as proof of focus loss.

Five dense opening samples were retained across three batches (2+2+1), each with a warm-up. Two attempts lost their opening record when the old guard failed. Dense opening is observational, not an unbiased five-consecutive-run gate.
The final independent monitor saw only Codex and dwm. A separate diagnostic verified dwm's foreground window was class Ghost, titled Codex (Not responding).
Opening measures a fresh content panel inside an existing host with cached artwork and two extra frames after readiness, excluding network download and host creation.
No native mesh/camera/texture disposal counts, GPU first-pixel timing, or matched pre-rewrite run were available.
